##### Project general facts

Crest Grande is a classy and elegant residential development located in the prestigious waterfront district. Featuring a collection of one to four-bedroom waterfront apartments, this development combines resort-style relaxation with stunning views of the Dubai skyline and the world's largest tower. With a payment plan designed for flexibility, Crest Grande offers a rare opportunity to own a piece of paradise in one of Dubai's most sought-after communities.

Residents enjoy an exceptional array of amenities designed to elevate everyday living. Indoor and outdoor gymnasiums cater to fitness enthusiasts, while a pristine adult and kids' swimming pool offers refreshing escapes. A sauna room provides relaxation, a dedicated playing area ensures children have their own space, and a dedicated barbecue zone is perfect for enjoying weekends with family and friends. Retail and restaurants within the community add convenience, while the waterfront boardwalk exclusive to residents offers the perfect setting for evening strolls.

Every residence at Crest Grande features modern finishing with high-quality materials, fully equipped kitchens, and thoughtfully designed layouts that maximize space and natural light. The interiors are crafted with contemporary elegance, creating homes that are both stylish and functional. The waterfront views and resort-style amenities make each residence a sanctuary of comfort and sophistication.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in the waterfront district of Sobha Hartland, this exceptional location offers a classy and cosmopolitan island lifestyle in the center of Dubai. Surrounded by untouched nature and soothing waterways, residents enjoy stunning views of the Dubai skyline and the world's largest tower, creating a perfect blend of urban sophistication and natural serenity.

The location is distinguished by its exclusive waterfront boardwalk, which is reserved for residents of the community. This private promenade offers the perfect setting for evening strolls, allowing residents to enjoy their evenings as is meant to be. The community's strategic positioning ensures easy access to Dubai's most iconic landmarks and vibrant districts, while maintaining a peaceful and resort-style atmosphere.

For those seeking a residence that embodies waterfront elegance, community connection, and a prime Dubai address, Sobha Hartland delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of natural beauty, world-class amenities, and strategic connectivity makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
